description: This file defines the StripeBillingService class implementing IBillingProviderService, providing methods for managing Stripe billing operations such as creating customers, payment intents, checkouts, subscriptions, invoices, and handling subscription status and usage records.

classes.name: StripeBillingService
classes.description: A service class implementing billing operations using Stripe API, including customer management, payment processing, subscription handling, invoice management, and status mapping.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer in Stripe with provided email and metadata.

methods.name: createPaymentIntent
methods.description: Creates a payment intent for a specified customer, amount, and metadata.

methods.name: createOneTimeCheckout
methods.description: Creates a one-time checkout session with specified price, quantity, URLs, and optional promotion codes.

methods.name: createSubscriptionCheckout
methods.description: Creates a subscription checkout session with detailed parameters including customer, URLs, price, and optional discounts and metadata.

methods.name: createPrice
methods.description: Creates a new price object in Stripe with specified amount, currency, interval, and product.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionCreation
methods.description: Method not implemented; throws an error if called.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionCancel
methods.description: Cancels a subscription in Stripe.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionUpdate
methods.description: Updates a subscription's items and proration behavior.

methods.name: handleEndTrial
methods.description: Ends the trial period for a subscription if it is currently trialing.

methods.name: checkoutSessionIsPaid
methods.description: Checks if a checkout session has been paid.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and maps the status of a subscription.

methods.name: getCheckoutSession
methods.description: Retrieves details of a checkout session.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer details from Stripe.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Lists subscriptions for a customer.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates customer metadata such as email and userId.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves a price object from Stripe.

methods.name: extractSubscriptionDates
methods.description: Converts Stripe subscription date fields from Unix time to Date objects.

methods.name: mapStripeStatusToCalStatus
methods.description: Maps Stripe subscription status strings to internal SubscriptionStatus enum.

methods.name: createInvoiceItem
methods.description: Creates an invoice item in Stripe.

methods.name: deleteInvoiceItem
methods.description: Deletes an invoice item in Stripe.

methods.name: createInvoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice in Stripe with specified parameters.

methods.name: finalizeInvoice
methods.description: Finalizes an invoice and returns its URL.

methods.name: voidInvoice
methods.description: Voids or deletes an invoice based on its status.

methods.name: getPaymentIntentFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the failure reason for a payment intent.

methods.name: hasDefaultPaymentMethod
methods.description: Checks if a customer or subscription has a default payment method.

methods.name: createSubscriptionUsageRecord
methods.description: Creates a usage record for a metered subscription item.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves detailed subscription info including items and status.

methods.name: listInvoices
methods.description: Lists invoices for a customer, optionally filtered by subscription and date range.

methods.name: extractPaymentMethod
methods.description: Extracts payment method details from Stripe PaymentMethod object.
